notes.title: Silentium Update Changelog
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
Fixed typos.
Fixed a bug that teleported players out of the map.
Additional minor bug fixes to performance issues.

[h3][b]Additions[/b][/h3]
Added new interactions.
Added new dialogue.
Added some new items in the world.

[h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3]
Temporarily disabled quest tracking.
Moved some items and interactable objects.
Balanced some abilities for combat.

[h2][b]New Content![/b][/h2]

[b]Health bars![/b]
Now you can finally see just how much (or how little) health and mana you or your enemies have dynamically during combat, without having to click on them or wait for your next turn! We will be improving upon this feature over the coming months to bring more detailed and real-time information to the player during combat. 

[b]Quest List HUD![/b]
There is now a new Quest HUD that allows you to see your currently active quests! As we continue to develop this, we're aiming to bring features like more streamlined quest tracking, display toggling, sorting, and a bunch of other neat stuff.

notes.title: Silentium Update Changelog
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b] 
Fixed some typos.
Fixed a few bugs that were preventing some animations from playing during combat.
Additional minor bug fixes to performance issues.

[b]Additions[/b] 
Added quest content in town.
Added new dialogue.
Added a few new items in the world.

[b]Changes[/b] 
Temporarily disabled party member switching.
Moved some interactions.
Balanced some abilities for combat.

[b]New Content![/b]
We've made some big changes to combat, including new abilities and some reworked animations. The Warrior, Mage, and Rogue classes now have more specialized skillsets to improve upon synergy between other characters and classes during combat. We will continue to implement new abilities and features as we develop Silentium, but here are a few descriptions for some of the new abilities you may find in this update.

Rogue-
Cheapshot: Life has not treated you well, and you’ve learned to survive… by any means. Take your weapon, and bludgeon the enemy in their weak spot.

Firebolt: Fire a quick bolt at the target. When firebolt hits the target, it will explode 2 squares around the targeted area.

Lethal Poison: Slash the target with blades covered in a poison coating. This attack never misses, but its efficiency may vary.

Mage-
Magic Missile: Cast magic missiles. Arcane energy surges at the enemy, and there is no hope for them to evade. Magic missiles always hit, but can never critically hit. 

Arcane Focus: Grant +2 Int and Will for 5 turns.

Arcane Siphon: The caster may replenish up to 15% of their MP reserves at the cost of 10% HP.

Fireball: The mage channels the power of Ryukk. Concentrating a burning ball of flame in through their weapon. The caster releases this powerful ball of flame.

Frost Nova: Focus a powerful explosion of ice from your hands, encasing your foes around you. This ability freezes any creature or humanoid in place. This ability will immobilize enemies 3 squares in each direction around the caster.

notes.title: First DevLog
notes.notes:
Greetings, Survivors! 
We hope everyone is having a great start to their 2023. We wanted to make sure to hop on and give everyone an update on how the development process of Silentium has been going. 

First things first, we have officially entered internal alpha. What that means at Eldersin is we have started to give the game to individuals that we can get hyper-focused feedback from. As we continue development up to release, we will open the development process to give keys to more players -- we thank you for your patience. When we do open up our testing phases, it will be focused on certain features of the game. Example: At Pax West we tested our turned based combat system and our dungeon layout. We received [i]critical [/i]feedback and are actively working to fine tune our numbers and shrink the size of our rooms. 

Secondly, our theory for the dungeon layout before was, leave wide open room space for exploration. The feedback we received again and again, was "the rooms are too big and feel like nothing is in them." Our current solution is adding what we call, "chunks". This allows us to create more of a flow to the dungeons, and reduce how much time is needed to run through dead-zones. 

[b]Before[/b]: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42825397/d3a62e1842d70ca9bdcceb81cd80d735b8084af6.png[/img]
[b]After[/b]: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42825397/e79bd3b2c216a4170c00c379a18635865c099bb2.png[/img]

This new level-design theory also allows us to get creative from the developer side. It allows us to put things like harvestables, chests, objectives, and lore easter eggs into corridors. 

Thirdly, another issue we addressed at Pax West was our HUD display for health bars. As well, as glowing boxes underneath characters/enemies -- for information or for those who are visually impaired. Currently, the UI in-game is good, [i]but [/i]we plan to make it better. We will be looking for any suggestions/feedback that [i]you[/i], the community, has to make the game better -- especially with UI. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42825397/81ebf39b7e4f583e46e8ed88a0beda0797ceea2c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42825397/ab0942b8267313fad5456e315d4623d1f78e2ad8.png[/img]

On the topic of UI, we also wanted to address the elephant in the room: Codex, our dungeon building mechanic. Currently, we are still integrating all assets, and props into the game, so Codex will still be [i]awhile [/i] ways out for testing. We are hopeful by the end of Closed Alpha, Codex will be available for testing. The current development plan is to integrate Codex slow, and provide chunks of the labyrinth to allow the testers to play around and see how the UI/in-game map maker works. Again, this is tentative and we will keep you all posted on the progress.

Lastly, we integrated harvestable items this month. We plan on adding an in-depth crafting system, for items such as potions and elixirs. So far during our testing, it's added a fun addition to combat and tactical gameplay. While it will also reward those who are brave enough to check every corner of the rooms and corridors. 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42825397/aeeb38d0fad6f1759e8da818074cb15f20273b16.png[/img]

Thank you all so much for your continued support and feedback! As we grow our team, we will hopefully be able to give more frequent updates. 
Feel free to tweet at us, at our twitter handle @EldersinStudios.
